scripts.docker:staging: docker compose --env-file deploy/staging/.env -f compose.release.yaml -f compose.staging.yaml up -d --build --wait
scripts.docker:production: docker compose --env-file deploy/production/.env -f compose.release.yaml -f compose.production.yaml up -d --no-build --wait
scripts.api:test: npm run api:build && npm run integration --workspace @keycaps/tests
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run api:test
scripts.docker:test:unit: docker compose -p keycaps-test -f compose.yaml -f compose.test.yaml --profile test run --build --rm unit
scripts.docker:test:e2e: docker compose -p keycaps-test -f compose.yaml -f compose.test.yaml --profile test run --build --rm e2e
scripts.docker:test:down: docker compose -p keycaps-test -f compose.yaml -f compose.test.yaml --profile test down
scripts.test:e2e: npm run api:build && npm run e2e --workspace @keycaps/tests
